user_saw: The model picker reopened on the current model's provider instead of Favorites when the current model was not starred, even though Favorites was the last tab chosen.
summary: Drops the condition that a remembered Favorites tab reopens only while it holds the selected model, so the picker reopens on Favorites whenever it was last chosen.
reasoning: The removed condition was added deliberately in 27592cd31c1d (#199051) with a doc comment ('A remembered Favorites tab opens only while it holds the selected model') and a test asserting exactly that behavior. The fix reverses that design choice and rewrites the docs accordingly, so it is a product behavior change, not a defect in the earlier code.
